name: co.origencapital/origen-capital
title: Origen Capital
description: US community lenders (CDFIs, credit unions, microlenders) by county, in English and Spanish.

tools.name: origen_financing_lookup
tools.description: The CDFIs, low-income credit unions, SBA microloan intermediaries, and ITIN-friendly national nonprofits serving a US county — the lenders that say yes when a bank says no. By lane (business, home, personal), in English or Spanish. Splits institutions headquartered in the county from those with only a walk-in branch there; a county with no door at all is answered honestly with the state tier. Every record names its federal source and vintage. Public federal data; nobody pays to be listed; no borrower information is asked or taken.

lane.description: 'business', 'home', or 'personal' — plain words and Spanish work too ('negocio', 'vivienda', 'préstamo personal')

county.description: US county name, e.g. 'Harris County'. A city name also works and resolves to its county ('Houston' → Harris County).

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

itin.description: true when the borrower has an ITIN and no SSN — the answer leads with verified ITIN-friendly options

types.description: Optional: keep only these kinds of institution (any match). Omit for all.

tools.name: origen_institution
tools.description: Find an institution in the directory by name (optionally narrowed to a state) or by the id a lookup returned. Returns its kind, certifications, lanes, head-office county, every county where it keeps a door, and the federal list and vintage it comes from. Answers 'not in the directory' plainly — most banks are not in it by design.

name.description: Institution name or part of it, e.g. 'Mission Asset Fund'

state.description: US state name or two-letter code (optional)

id.description: An id from a previous lookup, e.g. 'california/mission-asset-fund-cdfi' (optional; overrides name)

tools.name: origen_home_loan_approvals
tools.description: How often home-purchase applications in a US county were approved or denied in the latest HMDA year, the most common reasons for denial, and the lenders that made the most home loans there — each with applications, loans made, denial rate and median rate. From the federal Home Mortgage Disclosure Act public loan records. Counts and rates only; nothing is ranked or recommended. Small lenders below HMDA's reporting threshold, including many credit unions in the directory, are not counted.

county.description: US county name, e.g. 'Harris County'. A city name also works ('Houston' → Harris County).

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

tools.name: origen_financing_coverage
tools.description: Coverage of the Origen Capital directory. Without arguments: national totals, per-lane counts, sources with vintages and refresh cycles. With a state: its county coverage and largest county lists, so an agent can form a valid lookup.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code (optional)
